metadata.description: ceciCela marketplace: ceci plans this, cela proves that, trouble fixes what breaks. The bundle and each skill on its own.

plugins.name: cecicela
plugins.description: ceciCela: ceci plans this, cela proves that, trouble fixes what breaks. The /ceci job graph with human gates, the /cela evidence gate where a tool names the result, and the /trouble four-roles debug protocol, in one plugin.

plugins.name: ceci
plugins.description: ceci turns a goal into a job graph, runs ready jobs in dependency order, stops at human gates before contact, posting, payment, or pricing, places GPU jobs, and gates code changes with /cela. Part of ceciCela.

plugins.name: cela
plugins.description: cela is an evidence-first protocol for AI coding agents. A bundled tool runs the checks and names the result (COMPLETE, STALLED, BLOCKED, MISSING_TEST), so the model never grades its own work. Part of ceciCela.

plugins.name: trouble
plugins.description: Stop looping on a bug you cannot close. /trouble is a four-roles debug protocol that collects verbatim evidence, ranks hypotheses with Bayesian math, and refuses a fix until the roles unanimously agree. Part of ceciCela.
